# Pax26 — AI-Powered WhatsApp Commerce Platform

> Pax26 helps African and global businesses sell more on WhatsApp using AI automation, a built-in online storefront, and intelligent chatbots — all managed from one dashboard.

## What is Pax26?

Pax26 is a SaaS platform that combines:
- **WhatsApp Business Automation** — automated replies, lead follow-ups, bulk messaging
- **AI Sales Chatbot** — a 24/7 conversational agent that qualifies leads and drives WhatsApp sales
- **Online Storefront** — a hosted product catalogue page customers can browse and order from
- **Order & Inventory Management** — track sales, orders, and stock from your dashboard
- **Payment Integration** — accept payments directly via WhatsApp conversations

## Key Features

- Build an AI-powered WhatsApp store in minutes
- Automate customer conversations and follow-ups
- Convert WhatsApp chats into confirmed orders 24/7
- Manage your product catalogue, inventory, and pricing in one dashboard
- Accept payments and track orders in real time
- Broadcast promotions to your WhatsApp contact list
- Multi-agent inbox to manage customer chats as a team

## Target Audience

Small and medium-sized businesses in Africa and globally who sell products or services and want to use WhatsApp as their primary sales and customer support channel.

## Pricing

Pax26 offers tiered subscription plans:
- **Starter** — Free plan with basic store and limited automation
- **Pro** — Full AI automation, unlimited products, priority support
- **Business** — Team features, advanced analytics, dedicated onboarding

Visit https://www.pax26.com/#pricing for current pricing.

## Technology

Pax26 is built with Next.js 15 App Router (React Server Components), hosted on Vercel, and integrates with the WhatsApp Business API via Meta.
